# AIWebHub

> AIWebHub is a web design and AI integration agency based in Michigan, USA. We build custom websites, integrate AI-powered features, develop e-commerce solutions, and connect POS systems for modern businesses. Founded in 2024, AIWebHub serves clients across the United States with a focus on innovative technology and measurable results.

## Services

- Custom Website Design & Development (landing pages, multi-page business sites, e-commerce stores)
- AI Integration (chatbots, intelligent search, personalized recommendations, automated content)
- Custom AI Agents (agent development, knowledge base training, API integrations)
- AI Training (hands-on sessions teaching client teams to build and operate AI agents on their own processes)
- Automation Audits (process mapping and a written assessment of which business tasks are worth automating)
- Agentic Workflow Implementation (end-to-end AI agent workflows built into a client's existing systems)
- E-commerce Solutions (online stores with secure payment processing and inventory management)
- POS System Integration (connecting point-of-sale systems with web platforms)
- SEO Optimization (search engine optimization and digital strategy)
- Website Maintenance & Support (ongoing hosting, updates, and performance monitoring)

## Pricing

AIWebHub does not sell fixed packages or publish price tiers. Every project is scoped to the client's goals and quoted individually, with a clear breakdown of what is included; most quotes go out within 24 hours. To get a quote, use the contact page: https://www.aiwebhub.io/contact

For independent, survey-sourced industry cost ranges (not AIWebHub's prices), see the website cost calculator: https://www.aiwebhub.io/tools/website-cost-calculator

- Static site generation for optimal performance
